name: us-you-be-the-president
description: You Be the President — Unit 4 U.S. History decision game (TEKS 8.5A–H, 8.17B, 8.22A, 8.31B). Seven real crises from Washington to Jackson, three choices each. A choice is right when it matches what the real president actually decided — then a What Really Happened card reveals his reasons and the outcome. Server-authoritative Socket.IO backend with a live Teacher Command Center.
comment: No npm workspaces: this drive is exFAT, which cannot host the symlinks/junctions workspace linking requires. server/ and client/ install independently; `npm install` here cascades via postinstall.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --no-fund --no-audit && npm install --prefix client --no-fund --no-audit
